# kozmotic

> Portable CLI toolkit for AI agents. Subcommands emit
> structured JSON so they compose inside Claude Code
> hooks, status lines, and slash commands.

## Project Identity

- Language: Rust (edition 2024, stable)
- Workspace: `crates/kozmotic` (CLI), `xtask` (dev tasks)
- Target platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS

## Subcommands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `kozmotic example` | Reference for new tools |
| `kozmotic agent-ping` | Play notification sounds |
| `kozmotic status-line` | Format session JSON for the status bar |
| `kozmotic self install` | Install into `~/.claude/bin/` |

Global flag: `--format json|human` (default `json`).

## Build Commands

```
cargo xtask validate          # fmt + clippy + tests + coverage
cargo xtask test [filter]     # tests only
cargo xtask clippy            # lint only
cargo xtask fmt               # format code
cargo xtask check             # fast compile check
cargo xtask coverage          # coverage check (>=90%)
cargo xtask dupes             # code duplication check (<=6%)
```

PowerShell entry: `.\build.ps1 <command>` (validate,
test, clippy, fmt, check, coverage, build, clean).

## Quality Gates

- `#[deny(warnings)]`, `#[forbid(unsafe_code)]`
- Clippy pedantic with a curated allow-list
- 90% line coverage minimum (85% per module)
- Code duplication <= 6% (production code, tests
  excluded)
- `cargo fmt` enforced (max width 80)

## Conventions

- Conventional Commits with `AI-Generated:` footer
- Semantic Versioning (source of truth:
  `crates/kozmotic/Cargo.toml`)
- Keep a Changelog format in `CHANGELOG.md`
- LF line endings, 80-char line width

## Template Origin

Generated from the
[rustbase](https://github.com/breki/rustbase) template.
Sync state lives in `.template-sync.toml`. Template
feedback is logged in
`docs/developer/template-feedback.md`.
